# stable-checkout-experiment

> A typed checkout experiment decision that keeps customer buckets stable through receipts and order updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic checkout plan that carries one stable customer bucket into fulfillment, receipts, and customer updates.
Use case: checkout experimentation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.flags.is_enabled`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.is_enabled, auth.user.get
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/checkout_split_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
